text: 57 million people are losing their memories. And storage just tripled in price.
What if your footage could remember for you...
and show you how?
This is nimbytes. An AI-powered filesystem, built on Meta AI.
Built for everyone running out of space, with an accessibility helper for everyday independence.
This video is 3.4 gigabytes, and takes zero bytes on your disk.
Open it, and it plays near real-time, like it's local.
Meta AI analyzes the entire library, so you search the way you wanted.
Search your footage like text.
Search by what was said.
Or by who was there.
It spots duplicates and near-copies on its own,
scores how alike they are, and frees the space for you.
Create video explainers, automatically. And let Meta AI agents work.
SAM provides a step-by-step process and read each aloud.
Flip first chicken breast over in hot pan.
Or use it to show someone how to do the laundry, fix a leaky tap, make a video call, use the TV remote, or reset the Wi-Fi.
A letter arrives? Snap it, and nimbytes summarizes for you.
Water bill, $142.60.
What it says and what to do next, read aloud for anyone who finds small print hard to see.
Six Meta models do the work.
Muse Spark understands, SAM sees, Perception Encoder remembers, and more.
nimbytes.
Your AI-powered filesystem.
